title: Our Story
content:
Born in Beirut

The Hoodie LB started with a simple idea: everyone deserves to feel wrapped in comfort. What began as a small project between friends in Lebanon has grown into a brand that delivers coziness across the region.

Each hoodie is designed to be more than clothing — it is a wearable blanket that turns any moment into a cozy one. From movie nights to study sessions, from lazy Sundays to chilly commutes, we have got you covered (literally).

Our Promise

We use only premium Sherpa fleece, oversized cuts that fit everyone, and colours inspired by the Lebanese landscape — from Mediterranean sand to cedar green.
metaDescription: Learn about The Hoodie LB — cozy wearable blankets born in Beirut, Lebanon.

title: Shipping & Delivery
content:
Shipping Information

We deliver across Lebanon and the Middle East.

Lebanon

Free delivery on all orders. Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days. Express delivery (next business day) is available for an additional fee.

Middle East

We ship to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, and Iraq. International shipping typically takes 5-10 business days.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email and SMS.
metaDescription: Shipping information for The Hoodie LB. Free delivery across Lebanon.

title: Returns & Exchanges
content:
Return Policy

We want you to love your Hoodie LB. If for any reason you are not satisfied, we offer hassle-free returns within 30 days of delivery.

How to Return

Contact us at returns@thehoodielb.com with your order number. We will send you a return label. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging.

Exchanges

Want a different size or colour? We offer free exchanges on all orders. Same process — just let us know what you would like instead.

Refunds

Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
metaDescription: 30-day hassle-free returns on all Hoodie LB products.

title: Size Guide
content:
Finding Your Size

Our hoodies are designed to be oversized — that is the point! But here is a guide to help you choose:

Adult Hoodies

XS fits heights 150-160cm, S fits 160-170cm, M fits 165-175cm, L fits 170-180cm, XL fits 175-185cm, XXL fits 180-195cm. When in doubt, go with your regular clothing size — the oversized fit is already built in.

Kids Hoodies

Size 4 fits ages 3-4, Size 6 fits ages 5-6, Size 8 fits ages 7-8, Size 10 fits ages 9-10, Size 12 fits ages 11-12.

Slippers

S fits shoe sizes 36-37, M fits 38-39, L fits 40-41, XL fits 42-44.
metaDescription: Size guide for The Hoodie LB hoodies, kids wear, and slippers.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
content:
FAQ

How do I wash my hoodie?

Machine wash on cold, gentle cycle. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not bleach or iron directly on the Sherpa fleece.

Are your products suitable for hot weather?

Our Lightweight Hoodie is designed for year-round comfort. The Classic and Fleece-Lined versions are best for cooler weather.

Do you offer gift wrapping?

Yes! Add gift wrapping at checkout for a small fee. We will include a handwritten note if you provide a message.

Can I cancel my order?

Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placement. After that, the order enters processing and cannot be cancelled — but you can return it once received.
metaDescription: Common questions about The Hoodie LB products, shipping, and care.
